text:
Anya: Heads-up — UX question: should Console show an "effective cache credit" column in the per-route cost table or an overlay sparkline? I'm leaning overlay so we don't cram the table. Thoughts?
Ben: overlay seems cleaner, but ops needs quick exportable numbers for invoices. CSV-first constraint.
Corey: overlay + hover details works. Hover should show exact credit units, cache-hit delta, and sample_rate. Export can come from the underlying API endpoint.
Maya: +1 on hover. Also add a time-window selector (1h / 24h / 7d) — cache warmups and spikes matter for billing.
Anya: Implementation Q: do we compute effective_cache_credit at query time from route batch lineage, or maintain a precomputed amortized-credit table per route? Performance vs fidelity.
Ben: precomputed hourly/amortized slabs will be far cheaper for the UI. Query-time recompute OK for ad-hoc deep dives but not for the main dashboard.
Corey: hybrid approach sounds right — hourly slabs for the UI, detail endpoint that recomputes for a route+time-range when the user clicks "drill down".
Corey: SQL sketch (prototype):
```
SELECT route_id, slab_hour, SUM(credit_units) AS credit_units, AVG(sample_rate) AS sample_rate, model_sku
FROM route_cache_slabs
WHERE slab_hour BETWEEN :start AND :end AND route_id = :route
GROUP BY route_id, slab_hour, model_sku;
```
Maya: For canary rollouts — how do we show per-model-variant credit delta? Need an A/B overlay with percent delta and significance.
cost-bot: metric deployed — "route_cache_credit_amortized" available in telemetry v1.2. Query `/metrics?name=route_cache_credit_amortized&group_by=route` for quick pulls.
Anya: Nice. For the delta view I'd like an option: overlay canary - baseline or show both sparklines stacked. If delta > 10% highlight in amber and surface raw numbers.
Ben: I'll prototype the slab precompute job (hourly) and add a feature flag `ui.route_cache_overlay`. Starting retention: 14d, configurable per-tenant.
Corey: I'll add the hover API and CSV export (`/api/v1/costs/route/:id/credits?start=..&end=..&format=csv`). Canary overlay via `?compare_to=baseline` param.
Maya: Mockups incoming tomorrow morning. Quick question: should integrated alerts trigger on absolute token credit increase or relative (pct)? Ops will prefer absolute thresholds.
Anya: both. Show pct by default, but alerting rule UI should allow absolute token-credit thresholds. I'll write a short RFC and ping product. :rocket:
Ben: cc @Corey I'll hand off the job spec in ~2 days.
Corey: ack. I'll stub the endpoint and wire a sample CSV in the dev console.
Maya: thanks. Everyone, drop any edgecases here (multi-model chains, mixed sample rates).
Anya: adding a checklist in the console-rfcs thread. Short follow-up: add test vectors for a route with heavy prefetch -> credit attribution sanity check.
Ben: noted. Will include unit + integration tests and a small local sim harness. :white_check_mark:
Corey: cool. I'll post API proto and sample response format once sketched.
Maya: will share mocks and accessibility notes.
Anya: thanks all — moving this to action items.
